title: The library where you borrow your garden
text: In Fernhaven, the old lifeboat station on Quay Street no longer holds a lifeboat. Its long drawers hold seed packets — hundreds of varieties, every one free to borrow. Founder Maren Odell, a retired schoolteacher, still opens up most mornings, though the place is kept going by a rota of volunteers. Borrowers promise just one thing: save seed from what you grow, and bring some back.
notes: Lifestyle-magazine register. Legitimate source: location, purpose, founder, staffing, and a vague collection size ('hundreds of varieties') consistent with the annual report's 857.
